title: Full Stack Developer
description:
We're hiring: Full Stack Developer (1–2 years experience)

Bairuha Tech is looking for a full stack developer to join our team in Kozhikode, Kerala.

What you'll do:

* Build and ship features across the front end and back end
* Work with design and product to turn ideas into working software
* Write clean, testable code and take part in code reviews

What we're looking for:

* 1–2 years of hands-on experience building web applications.
* Comfortable with React / Node.js / Next.js/Reat native/Nest.
* Working knowledge of databases PostgreSQL / MongoDB]and REST APIs
* Familiarity with Git and basic CI/CD
* Strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn — we care more about how you think than the years on your CV

Good knowledge of -Docker / AWS

Location: On-site

Type: Full-time

How to apply: send your CV and GitHub profile to manish@bairuhatech.com,hr@bairuhatech.com, directly.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Experience:

* total work: 2 years (Preferred)
* REACT: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
